title: Physical Activity With Tailored E-health Support for Individuals With Intellectual Disability
brief_summary: The main objective of this project is to enhance physical activity in youths and adults with intellectual disabilities (IDs) by developing and testing a tailored e-heath support for motivation and participation in physical activity.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Intellectual disability
* Age 15-60 years
* Low physical activity
* Sedentary lifestyle

Exclusion Criteria:

* Medical contradictions for participation
* High levels of physical activity
